---
title: "Jobs and unemployment"
description: "How many people are in work, and the unemployment rate."
---

The unemployment rate peaked at 16.1% in late 2011 and has been below 5% for most of the period since 2022. Unemployment among people aged 15 to 24 has been higher than the overall rate throughout, and rises further in downturns.
